description: This is a test class for VoiceRecognitionTrigger, testing its behavior with different input method configurations and intent activities in an Android environment.

classes.name: VoiceRecognitionTriggerTest
classes.description: Test class for VoiceRecognitionTrigger, verifying its behavior with different input method configurations and intent activities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mock objects and sets up common test data before each test.

methods.name: addInputMethodInfo
methods.description: Adds a mock InputMethodInfo with specified modes to the inputMethods list.

methods.name: testImeNotInstalledWhenNoVoice
methods.description: Verifies that the input method is not considered installed when no voice input methods are present.

methods.name: testImeInstalledWhenOnlyVoice
methods.description: Verifies that the input method is considered installed when only voice input method is present.

methods.name: testImeInstalledWhenMixedVoice
methods.description: Verifies that the input method is considered installed when mixed input methods including voice are present.

methods.name: testIntentNotInstalledWhenNoActivities
methods.description: Verifies that the intent is not considered installed when no activities are available.

methods.name: testIntentInstalledWhenSomeActivity
methods.description: Verifies that the intent is considered installed when at least one activity is available.

methods.name: testVoiceRecognitionTriggerNoneWhenNothing
methods.description: Checks that the trigger returns 'none' when no input methods or activities are available.

methods.name: testVoiceRecognitionTriggerPrioritizesIme
methods.description: Checks that the trigger prioritizes IME when a voice input method is available.

methods.name: testVoiceRecognitionTriggerFallsBackToIntent
methods.description: Checks that the trigger falls back to intent when voice IME is not available.

methods.name: testVoiceRecognitionTriggerAcceptsIme
methods.description: Verifies that the trigger recognizes voice IME input method.
